grasp.rationale: Candidate 1 is the constructed handle_center point, which represents the center of the teapot handle. For grasping the teapot handle, this is the ideal interaction point as it sits at the midpoint of the handle loop where a hand would naturally grip. It is consistently visible across multiple views and correctly positioned on the handle structure.

transport_active.rationale: The stage requires carrying the spout tip over the mug opening. Candidate 3 is the constructed spout_tip point, located at the very tip of the teapot spout — the exact point that needs to be positioned over the mug opening for pouring. This is clearly visible across multiple views as the outermost point of the spout.

pour.rationale: The stage is 'tilt about the spout tip to pour', so the interaction point must be the spout tip. Candidate 3 is the constructed spout_tip point, which is consistently shown at the very tip/end of the spout across all views. This is the exact point about which the teapot tilts to pour liquid into the mug.

transport_passive.rationale: The stage requires the mug opening (rim) as the interaction point where a spout must reach. Candidate 2 is the constructed opening_center at the rim, which represents the center of the mug's opening. This is the most appropriate anchor point for a spout reaching the mug opening, as it defines the geometric center of the rim opening where liquid would be poured in.
